articles.title: Goodbye Notch, Hello Invisible Face ID: Metalenz's Under-Display Breakthrough
articles.summary: Metalenz's Polar ID system uses polarization data to securely unlock your phone—and now it can hide beneath the screen. This flat-lens tech could finally give Android a true Face ID rival without the ugly cutout, arriving in devices by 2028.

articles.title: Mother's Day Gift Guide: Legit Deals on Mom-Tested Favorites
articles.summary: We scoured sales for Mother's Day (May 10) and found genuine discounts on gifts vetted by real moms: a stylish indoor garden, a self-heating mug, the latest Kindle, and more. Shop now to avoid the last-minute scramble.

articles.title: Jenna Elfman to Spar with Stephen Fry in Fox's Mind-Bending Spy Drama 'The Interrogator'
articles.summary: Jenna Elfman joins the cast of Fox's 'The Interrogator' as a disgraced CIA agent forced to wrangle Stephen Fry's eccentric MI6 operative, who uses psychological tactics to crack criminals. The 12-episode series promises a clash of wits and grudging respect.
